paragraphs: Your local, firefighter-owned team. South Louisiana roots. Personal service.
Saint Gabriel, Louisiana · Iberville Parish

Give your Saint Gabriel lawn consistent care through the seasons. Our local, firefighter-owned team combines liquid fertilization, weed prevention, and targeted weed control with clear pricing, service photos, and personal attention.
Free estimate · Seasonal planned visits · No long-term contract
Consistent care. Clear monthly pricing.

Your lawn program brings together seasonal nutrition, weed prevention, targeted weed control, and monitoring. We review the turf and property details, then explain the recommended care and price before you approve.
Monthly billing covers the year-round lawn program; it does not mean monthly treatments. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract.
Free, no-obligation estimate
Tell us about your home or light commercial property and the lawn concerns you want addressed. We’ll review the details and prepare your treatment price. Fields marked * are required.
Choose an address suggestion or enter your details manually.
No payment required. Your service address helps us confirm coverage and prepare accurate pricing.
Our office hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM.

Please enable JavaScript to use the quote form, or call (225) 461-3199 for your estimate.
Thanks for reaching out to Grow Green. Our team will review your property details and contact you about your lawn treatment estimate. This is a quote request, not a scheduled treatment.
A sunny front lawn and a shaded backyard can need different attention. We consider grass type, moisture, weeds, and trouble spots so treatment reflects the property.
Our liquid program pairs seasonal nutrition with weed prevention and targeted control. Products and timing are selected for the grass, active problems, and application conditions.
We review the lawn’s response and monitor insect and disease concerns as the seasons change. Visit photos and notes explain the work and any watering, mowing, or other aftercare.
Tell us what is spreading. We identify the weed and consider the surrounding grass before recommending control.
Virginia buttonweed, doveweed, dollarweed, and beggarweed can need different products and timing.
Yellow and purple nutsedge, crabgrass, and other grassy weeds are reviewed by species and turf type.
Ask about a separate specialty plan. We review the lawn and explain the scope, price, and timing before you approve.
What we apply, and when
Saint Gabriel’s warm-season lawns respond differently to active growth, summer heat, and cooler weather. We adjust nutrition, weed management, and monitoring to the grass and conditions.
Time feeding to active growth, address early weeds, and use preventive treatments at appropriate seasonal windows.
Adjust nutrition and weed control for heat, moisture, and turf response while monitoring seasonal insect activity.
Shift nutrition as growth slows, manage cool-season weed pressure, and watch for seasonal disease concerns.
Monitor lawn conditions and winter weeds. Dormant warm-season grass does not need the same nitrogen feeding as actively growing summer turf.
This is an overview of seasonal priorities. Actual products, rates, and visit timing depend on turf needs, weather, and label directions.
Know the grass. Match the care.
Centipede, St. Augustine, bermuda, and zoysia need different care. We consider sunlight, moisture, and mowing along with the grass type when choosing nutrition and weed-control treatments.
Learn more: LSU AgCenter’s Louisiana Lawn Maintenance guide (PDF) and UF/IFAS centipedegrass guidance .
Firefighter-owned. Personally invested.

Grow Green is a firefighter-owned company based in St. Amant, serving Saint Gabriel and surrounding South Louisiana communities. Owner Dereck and the team put a local name behind your lawn care, with service photos, visit notes, and an office you can reach.

Have a concern between visits? Contact our office with what you’re seeing. We’ll review the issue, explain the next step, and help you understand any treatment or maintenance changes your lawn may need.
We serve residential lawns and light commercial properties in Saint Gabriel, including neighborhoods near LA-30 and River Road. Share your address so we can confirm coverage.
Nearby service areas include Geismar, Gonzales, Prairieville, Dutchtown, Addis, and Plaquemine. Availability is confirmed for your specific property.
Explore nearby service pages
Clear answers before you start
Answers about coverage, treatment visits, monthly billing, and getting your property ready.

Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Timing and applications depend on the season, weather, and turf condition. Each visit serves a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.

Your estimate is based on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean a treatment every month.
No. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract. Your estimate explains the recommended service, price, and terms before you approve.

Response varies with the weed species, grass, temperature, rainfall, and condition of the lawn. Some weeds begin responding after treatment, while persistent problems can need repeated or specialized care. We explain what to watch for in your service notes; a greener, denser lawn develops with consistent care and appropriate maintenance.

Yes. The program includes seasonal weed prevention and targeted control of existing weeds. Products and timing are selected for the grass, weed species, and conditions. Persistent weeds may need ongoing or additional targeted care, which we review with you.

Both liquid and granular products can be effective when selected and applied appropriately. Our regular lawn program uses liquid applications to deliver seasonal nutrition, micronutrients, and weed-control treatments suited to the turf. Products are combined only when appropriate for the application and label directions.

Dallisgrass is evaluated for a separate specialty plan. Let us know where it is growing and choose the dallisgrass option on the quote form. We explain the recommended scope, timing, and price before you approve.

We serve residential lawns and light commercial properties in Saint Gabriel, including the Sunshine and Carville areas and neighborhoods near LA-30 and River Road. Nearby service areas include Geismar, Gonzales, Prairieville, Dutchtown, Addis, and Plaquemine. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability for your property.

Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and share any access restrictions or sensitive areas. We provide service notes and product-specific directions for watering, mowing, and other aftercare.

Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

Yes. Flower-bed weed control, fire ant service, tree and shrub care, core aeration, and liquid aeration are separate services we can discuss with your estimate. Seasonal insect and disease care follow the lawn program’s scope. Additional targeted treatments may have a separate price, which we explain before you approve.

Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.

    Clear answers before you start

    Saint Gabriel lawn care,
    clearly explained.

    Answers about coverage, treatment visits, monthly billing, and getting your property ready.

    Talk with our team
    How often do you treat lawns in Saint Gabriel?

    Our annual lawn program includes seasonal planned visits, generally about six weeks apart. Timing and applications depend on the season, weather, and turf condition. Each visit serves a purpose; eight visits do not mean eight identical fertilizer applications.

    How is lawn treatment priced and billed?

    Your estimate is based on the measured treatable lawn area, property conditions, and selected services. The annual year-round lawn program price is divided into twelve monthly payments. Monthly billing does not mean a treatment every month.

    Is there a long-term contract?

    No. Service is month-to-month with no long-term contract. Your estimate explains the recommended service, price, and terms before you approve.

    How soon will I see results?

    Response varies with the weed species, grass, temperature, rainfall, and condition of the lawn. Some weeds begin responding after treatment, while persistent problems can need repeated or specialized care. We explain what to watch for in your service notes; a greener, denser lawn develops with consistent care and appropriate maintenance.

    Is weed control included?

    Yes. The program includes seasonal weed prevention and targeted control of existing weeds. Products and timing are selected for the grass, weed species, and conditions. Persistent weeds may need ongoing or additional targeted care, which we review with you.

    Is liquid-only better than granular?

    Both liquid and granular products can be effective when selected and applied appropriately. Our regular lawn program uses liquid applications to deliver seasonal nutrition, micronutrients, and weed-control treatments suited to the turf. Products are combined only when appropriate for the application and label directions.

    Can you handle dallisgrass?

    Dallisgrass is evaluated for a separate specialty plan. Let us know where it is growing and choose the dallisgrass option on the quote form. We explain the recommended scope, timing, and price before you approve.

    Which areas and property types do you serve?

    We serve residential lawns and light commercial properties in Saint Gabriel, including the Sunshine and Carville areas and neighborhoods near LA-30 and River Road. Nearby service areas include Geismar, Gonzales, Prairieville, Dutchtown, Addis, and Plaquemine. Send your street address and ZIP code so we can confirm availability for your property.

    Do I need to be home, and how should I prepare?

    Usually not, as long as we can access the scheduled treatment area. Unlock gates, secure pets, and share any access restrictions or sensitive areas. We provide service notes and product-specific directions for watering, mowing, and other aftercare.

    When can children and pets return to the lawn?

    Keep people and pets away from the treatment area during application. Follow the specific re-entry directions provided for the products used. A single waiting period does not apply to every treatment.

    Can I add flower-bed, fire ant, or other treatments?

    Yes. Flower-bed weed control, fire ant service, tree and shrub care, core aeration, and liquid aeration are separate services we can discuss with your estimate. Seasonal insect and disease care follow the lawn program’s scope. Additional targeted treatments may have a separate price, which we explain before you approve.

    Will fertilizer fix thin grass or bare spots?

    Not always. Shade, moisture, mowing, insects, disease, and soil conditions can affect the lawn. Tell us what you are seeing so we can review the cause and recommend an appropriate next step. Fertilizer cannot revive dead grass or correct drainage problems by itself.
